evidence.method: 147 long-form (>= 20 min) videos from 8 focus-music searches published in the last 90 days, ranked by views per channel subscriber (floored at 1,000); top 30 reviewed, at most 2 per channel.
evidence.not_used: Bright clickbait text over brains or faces (#3 MEMORIZE FASTER, #26 ADHD FOCUS) ranked, but they sell brainwave or medical claims this channel does not make.

rules: 16:9 landscape YouTube thumbnail that still reads clearly at phone size.
No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks besides the phrase given.
Every object is plain and unbranded: no brand names, logos or trademarks anywhere.
No real or famous person and no recognisable face; any person is seen from behind, from above or in silhouette.
One clear subject, strong contrast, uncluttered.
text_policy: Every phrase in texts is short and makes no claim about brainwaves, Hz, ADHD, memory or health; the visual styles keep the brand's charcoal, graphite, warm amber and cool white with muted electric accents (ADR-0044), except the deliberately bright meme style.

cinematic_workspace_vista.label: Cinematic workspace with a view
cinematic_workspace_vista.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic photograph of {scene}, in a minimal high-end interior with a floor-to-ceiling window that opens onto {vista}. A clean desk with an open laptop and a warm desk lamp sits in the lower third. Soft evening or blue-hour light, soft haze, deep shadows, shot on a wide 24 mm lens, charcoal and graphite tones with warm amber lamp light.
cinematic_workspace_vista.typography: Centered across the upper middle, render the words "{text}" in thin, elegant, very widely letter-spaced capital letters in soft white, with a subtle glow so it stays legible against the view.

electric_city_night.label: Electric city at night
electric_city_night.prompt: Cinematic night scene of {scene}, overlooking a vast rain-wet futuristic city with glowing towers. Muted electric cyan and warm amber light, volumetric fog, reflections on glass, a lone desk or terminal glowing in the foreground. Moody, high contrast, photorealistic digital art.
electric_city_night.typography: Render the words "{text}" large and bold in a condensed modern sans-serif, stacked on the left third, in bright white with a thin amber underline, so it reads instantly at small size.

over_shoulder_worker.label: Person working, seen from behind
over_shoulder_worker.prompt: Photorealistic moody photograph of a person deep in work at {scene}, seen from behind and slightly above so the face is not visible. Their hands are on a keyboard or they stand before a wall of sketches and notes. Dark room lit by a single warm lamp and the cool glow of a screen, shallow depth of field, cinematic grain.
over_shoulder_worker.typography: Across the top, render the word "{text}" in thin, very widely letter-spaced capital letters in white.

monumental_minimal.label: Monumental minimal architecture
monumental_minimal.prompt: Epic minimalist cinematic image of {scene} rendered as vast brutalist architecture: an enormous structure or hall that dwarfs a single tiny human figure standing in the distance. Desert dusk or misty blue light, one warm light source, huge negative space, sense of silence and scale, photorealistic.
monumental_minimal.typography: Render the word "{text}" in an elegant thin serif or wide-spaced capitals, small and centered in the empty space, in warm off-white.

meme_object_lowercase.label: One object, lowercase caption
meme_object_lowercase.prompt: Clean product-style studio photograph of {object} centered on a plain {background} background, soft natural shadow, lots of empty space, no other objects, crisp and bright like an internet meme image.
meme_object_lowercase.typography: Below the object, render the text "{text}" in bold lowercase sans-serif letters ending with a period, in near-black, centered.
objects: a pair of plain unbranded over-ear headphones
a single steaming plain white ceramic coffee mug
a plain unbranded matte black mechanical keyboard
a simple brass desk lamp switched on
a closed plain black notebook with a pen on top

cozy_retreat_desk.label: Cozy retreat workstation
cozy_retreat_desk.prompt: Photorealistic cozy photograph of {scene}, reimagined as a warm hideaway: a glowing desk setup with soft blankets, a crackling fireplace and a large window showing a snowy mountain valley at dusk. Warm amber interior light against cool blue outside, inviting and calm.
cozy_retreat_desk.typography: Render the words "{text}" in soft white, widely letter-spaced capitals, across the upper sky area.
